profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a passion for creating, improving, and innovating. Strong experience with developing code in C++, JavaScript, and Golang, and also working directly with customers.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed websites for customers using WordPress, Wix, Webflow website builders
- Worked on integrating plugins and backend databases, and SEO compliance, and making websites fast-loading, secure, and accessible
- Developed websites iteratively ensuring compliance with customer requirements
- Built portfolio websites from the ground up using HTML5/CSS/JS
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · WordPress · Web Design · Back-End Web Development · Plugins

positions.title: Software Engineer - API Connect
positions.description:
- Worked on Migration Utility for API Connect to enhance customer's migration experience. Led numerous meetings with customers to remove blockers and identify pain points or issues. Developed migration code to ensure smooth customer migration experience.
- Wrapped Migration Utility codebase with extensive end-to-end, unit, and smoke testing using Mocha and JavaHarness. Configured Jenkins-CI pipelines to run tests automatically. 
- Worked on enhanced mapping feature in API Connect to quickly transform XML and JSON data into new formats.
- Quickly resolved urgent customer issues with the IBM API Connect product by
working closely with support and leading screen share calls with customers.
- Provided mentorship for other developers via detailed step-by-step walkthroughs on screenshare
- Worked on native Redact API feature. As a result customers can transform datasets at a much faster speed.

positions.title: Software Engineer - DataPower
positions.description: Worked on bug fixes, enhancements, and support for customers.

positions.description: Worked on a website for Ford Motor Company. Uses HTML5, Angular.JS, jQuery, JavaScript, CSS. Website designed to work offline and online, using browser cache.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Bootstrap (Framework) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML5
